description: The file `export_utils.php` contains utility functions for exporting data from the SuiteCRM platform, including CSV generation, data formatting, and supporting functions for handling related fields, search filters, and sample data generation.

classes.name: CleanCSV
classes.description: A helper class likely responsible for escaping CSV fields to ensure proper formatting.

methods.name: getDelimiter
methods.description: Retrieves the system default delimiter or user preference for exporting CSV files.

methods.name: printCSV
methods.description: Outputs CSV data with appropriate headers for download, handling character encoding and MIME types.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Builds a delimited string (CSV) for exporting records of a specified bean type, optionally including related data and sample rows.

methods.name: exportSample
methods.description: Generates a sample CSV export with instructional text, useful for demonstrating export format.

methods.name: returnFakeDataRow
methods.description: Creates sample data rows with dummy values for the purpose of sample exports.

methods.name: parseRelateFields
methods.description: Handles substitution of relate field placeholders in CSV lines with actual related data.

methods.name: generateSearchWhere
methods.description: Builds a SQL WHERE clause based on search form inputs for exporting filtered data.

methods.name: translateForExport
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for a field, considering language strings and field mappings.

methods.name: get_field_order_mapping
methods.description: Defines and retrieves the preferred order of fields for export, customizable per module.
